name: eightdegrees-sales-workflow
description: A lightweight client for published 8Degrees Activepieces flows. Commands: init, add-communication, reply-draft, report. Activepieces owns execution, queue state and scheduling; Portal holds exact-version reviews. Requires an already authorized Activepieces MCP connection. No direct mailbox, CRM, SMS or scheduler operations.
